title: Chatbot Response Accuracy Audit Log
description: A log of customer-facing chatbot responses to policy-sensitive questions, periodically sampled and reviewed against the current source-of-truth policy, with discrepancies and corrections recorded.
evidence_description: A structured log sampling chatbot responses to policy-sensitive questions (refunds, eligibility, pricing), each entry reviewed against the current source-of-truth policy document, with any discrepancy and its correction recorded.
collection_method: Automated sampling of conversation transcripts, reviewed by a policy owner on a recurring schedule.
retention_period: Minimum 3 years, aligned with typical consumer-protection record-keeping expectations.
artifact_format: Structured export (CSV/JSON) of sampled transcripts plus reviewer annotations.

citations.title: Moffatt v. Air Canada, 2024 BCCRT 149
citations.publisher: Civil Resolution Tribunal of British Columbia
